LanguageData.LP_Class_Barbarian.label: barbarian
LanguageData.LP_Class_Barbarian.description: A berserker fuelled by rage: the more hits taken, the fiercer and tougher.\nPower: rage power (Strength, Melee). Cannot use caster abilities while raging.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Ranger.label: ranger
LanguageData.LP_Class_Ranger.description: A hunter of the wilds who fights mainly with the bow, with a beast companion and favored enemies.\nPower: hunt power (Dexterity or Wisdom, Shooting or Melee, whichever is higher).
LanguageData.LP_Class_Rogue.label: rogue
LanguageData.LP_Class_Rogue.description: A trickster assassin: stealth, sneak attacks, one deadly strike.\nPower: cunning power (Dexterity, Melee or Shooting, whichever is higher).
